findings.title: subPath names a file the volume does not have
findings.cause: container app mounts /etc/group with subPath groups, but ConfigMap app-config has no such key (it has group), so the kubelet made an empty directory in its place: the runtime cannot mount that directory over the file /etc/group in the image, so the container never starts; Deployment app has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: failed to create containerd task: failed to create shim task: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: unable to start container process: error during container init: error mounting "/var/lib/kubelet/pods/99ae483d-edfa-4867-87b8-13572c423a39/volume-subpaths/config/app/0" to rootfs at "/etc/group": mount src=/var/lib/kubelet/pods/99ae483d-edfa-4867-87b8-13572c423a39/volume-subpaths/config/app/0, dst=/etc/group, dstFd=/proc/thread-self/fd/14, flags=MS_RDONLY|MS_BIND|MS_REC: not a directory

evidence.what: ConfigMap app-config has group, not groups
evidence.command: kubectl get configmap app-config -n kd-subpath-onto-file -o jsonpath='{.data}'

evidence.what: container app mounts volume config at /etc/group with subPath groups

findings.fix: Make subPath name a key ConfigMap app-config has, or add key groups to it; then delete the pod, because the directory the kubelet made stays until the pod is replaced (and a subPath mount never sees later updates to the ConfigMap).
